title.en: The philosopher chatbot lesson, written up for SgLDC
title.zh: 「哲学家聊天机器人」教学设计 · SgLDC 分享

summary.en: A Secondary 4 Higher Chinese lesson in which students debate a hawker's decision to raise prices with Confucius, Laozi and Mozi, each built as a chatbot persona in EdCafe.AI and delivered through SLS. The write-up earned the SgLDC Designer Badge from ETD.
summary.zh: 中四高级华文课例：学生就「小贩涨价」的道德两难，分别与孔子、老子、墨子对话辩证。三位思想家以 EdCafe.AI 建构人格化聊天机器人，通过 SLS 推送。此分享获教育技术司（ETD）颁发 SgLDC Designer Badge。
